result.summary: Found 4 issues, mostly minor layout/content cropping problems affecting horizontal card sections and one content truncation issue.

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccol...' restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section is cut off at the edge of the screen, with its name and delivery fee not fully visible.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal scroll cards are properly clipped/faded at the edge or add a partial preview indicator so users know to scroll.

issues.description: The category filter row (All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) is cut off on the right side, showing a partial pill element indicating more categories exist without clear scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add a fade gradient or scroll indicator arrow to signal horizontal scrollability.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' appears truncated with ellipsis due to card width, making it hard to read the full name.
issues.suggestion: Adjust card width or font size to accommodate full restaurant names, or ensure truncation is intentional with proper ellipsis styling.

issues.description: The pizza promotional image at the bottom lacks a title, description, or price information, unlike the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card above it, creating inconsistent card layouts.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent metadata (name, rating, delivery time, price) to all promotional/restaurant cards for uniformity.
